findings.description: The bucket is explicitly documented as public with no ACL set to private and no public access block configured, allowing unauthenticated users to read or write objects including sensitive customer data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects (including a customer master file) are stored unencrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in unencrypted public bucket
findings.description: A customer master spreadsheet is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer data to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, leaving stored objects unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects in the operations bucket are stored unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects in the data-science bucket are stored unencrypted at rest, despite versioning and logging being configured.
